dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I was just! Passing! Through! Seriously, how many times do I have to say it to get it through your thick metal head?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Drat... I felt bad when I spoke to her like that last time, and I really want to say sorry, but... Agh, it's so hard to say it out loud!)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm dumping off some excess scrap I don't need. Got them during an... uhh... a commission, yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (And I even went out of my way to get these components... Agh! What am I doing?! Come on, Jahoda, it's not that hard... just gotta apologize to Ineffa...)

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks a bunch!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! You're here too! Wow, today's a great day. Ineffa, get more krumkakes ready!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey there. Just dropped by to check in on things.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: #(Gah... How does {M#he}{F#she} say this stuff so naturally? Come on, I've gotta get it together...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ahem! Uh, Ineffa! About that t—time I, uhh... umm...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Called you a dumb-dumb metalface... That was on me. I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: As far as I am concerned, my face is indeed made of metal, so I agree with that aspect of your assessment. However, I disagree with the rest. The logic module that Aino created is not "dumb-dumb."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh? S—So, do you accept my apology or not...?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You do not need to apologize to me, Jahoda. You should be apologizing to my logic module. It is not a dumb-dumb, and neither is the one who made it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Aino, have you been fiddling with Ineffa's humor parameters again?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: ...Only because she asked me to. She didn't want to disappoint Jahoda, so I raised it... just a little bit.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So you're just making fun of me!?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I am not. As a matter of fact, the aforementioned module truly is all Jahoda needs to apologize for.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: A portion of said module's external monitoring port is located in my eye. Please make eye contact with me, and apologize to it.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Yikes...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Uh... O—Okay, I'll just spit it out...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, uh, logic module that Aino made for Ineffa...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Very well. My logic module and I forgive you, Jahoda.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Have this Lakkaberry Krumkake as your reward. It's freshly made.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #Aino, {NICKNAME}, you two are welcome to have some as well.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: *sigh* Finally...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (I... finally managed to say it... even though it turned out a little weird. That took more out of me than exploring a whole ruin...)

choices.text: It's alright. Ineffa's not mad at you.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I know. Still.. Is it just me, or is she a bit chattier than usual today?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Funny? Is she supposed to be funny... Wait, why are you bringing this up?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: And Ineffa! Don't take the krumkakes away, I haven't eaten mine!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: No. After all, you now need to apologize for something else.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Aino. Please adjust my humor level back to its default value.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Don't point that vacuum cleaner at me! Aino! What the heck's going on?!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: You will not leave until you are amused by my humor.
